an5.19:1.4: They are not personally accomplished in immersion, nor do they encourage others in immersion;
an5.19:1.5: They are not personally accomplished in wisdom, nor do they encourage others in wisdom;
an5.19:1.6: They are not personally accomplished in freedom, nor do they encourage others in freedom;
an5.19:1.7: They are not personally accomplished in the knowledge and vision of freedom, nor do they encourage others in the knowledge and vision of freedom.
